FINAL AUTONOMOUS DEPLOYMENT COMPLETION

Do not stop at infrastructure.

Complete the owner-authorized autonomous deployment system end to end.

Required flow:

1. Owner signs into IVX.
2. Validate owner session.
3. Create single-use deployment authorization.
4. Worker consumes authorization.
5. Execute GitHub Actions.
6. Monitor CI.
7. Deploy to Render.
8. Verify deployment.
9. Verify /health.
10. Verify /version.
11. Record deployment ledger.
12. Reject replay attempts.
13. Expire authorization automatically.
14. Return deployment proof inside IVX IA Chat.
15. Mark Autonomous Deployment as VERIFIED.

Deliver:
- GitHub Actions Run ID
- Commit SHA
- Render Deployment ID
- Worker Job ID
- Authorization ID (redacted if necessary)
- Deployment timestamps
- Health verification
- Version verification
- End-to-end execution logs

Do not mark COMPLETE until the entire owner → authorize → deploy → verify workflow has been executed successfully.
